description: This file contains test cases for Telegram channel binding functions, testing the normalization, matching, and resolution of conversation identifiers.

methods.name: normalizeTelegramAcpConversationId
methods.description: Normalizes a Telegram conversation ID, identifying whether it is a group topic and extracting parent id.

methods.name: matchTelegramAcpConversation
methods.description: Matches a Telegram conversation against known binding parameters, returning match priority and identifiers.

methods.name: resolveTelegramCommandConversation
methods.description: Resolves a command thread ID and originating target, returning a conversation ID and parent ID.
